67: 	if not game:hasEntity(self) then game:addEntity(self) end

109: function _M:getObjectCooldown()
110: 	local need = (self.use_power and self.use_power.power) or (self.use_talent and self.use_talent.power) or 0
111: 	if not self.power then return end
112: 	if self.power < need then
113: 		if self.power_regen and self.power_regen > 0 then
114: 			return math.ceil((need - self.power)/self.power_regen)
115: 		else
116: 			return nil
117: 		end
118: 	else
119: 		return 0
120: 	end

110: 		local diseases = t.getTargetDiseases(self, aitarget)
111: 		local tacs
112: 		if diseases then
113: 			tacs = {attackarea = {
114: 				BLIGHT = function(self, t, target)
115: 					if target == aitarget then -- blight damage only
116: 						return {diseases.num}
117: 					else -- blight damage with chance to disease
118: 						return {diseases.num, disease=diseases.num}
119: 					end
120: 				end
121: 				},
122: 				__wt_cache_turns = 1
123: 			}
124: 		end
125: 		return tacs
126: 	end,

130: 		return {type="ballbolt", radius=self:getTalentRadius(t), range=self:getTalentRange(t), friendlyfire=false, selffire=false, talent=t}

136:

140: 		-- Try to rot !

143: 			local target = game.level.map(px, py, engine.Map.ACTOR)
144: 			if not target then return end
145: 
146: 			diseases = t.getTargetDiseases(self, target)
